reference_method: Manual transcription from source-rendered PDF crops at 180 DPI, visually checked against the official scan pages. V8 adds one full-page dense English governance scan from the official 2026 Internal Corporate Governance Regulations; no text-layer or OCR output was used to transcribe that page.
protocol: Copy each selected region from its source PDF page, rasterize it at 216 DPI to remove any embedded OCR text layer, then run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF upload path (PyMuPDF/Tesseract fallback) with separate page-text and numeric-table render scales. Score manually transcribed text and reviewed financial row/value anchors.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only. This supplemental set contains three pages from one third-party Vietnamese scan packet and manually reviewed financial anchors; it is diagnostic, not representative model-selection evidence or safe automatic financial publication. It scores label/value association but has no separately annotated cell coordinates or paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.

CHAPTERI GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1. Scope of regulation and subjects of application 1.1. Seope of Regulation - This intemal corporate govemance regulation ("Regultion”) sets out the prineiples, mechanisms and procedures of corporate govemance aimed at protecting the lawful rights and interests of shareholders, and ensuring that corporate govenance is conducted in a transparent, effective manner and in compliance with applicable laws. This Regulation serves as a basis for shareholders and relevant stakeholders to assess the Company’s corporate governance practices. This Regulation applies to: Board members, the Chief Executive Director ("CEO”), Executive Directors, the Company Secretary, the Corporate Governance Officer, and other relevant individuals and departments. This Regulation governs matters relating to: a. Roles, rights and obligations of the General Meeting of Shareholders (“the GMS”), the Board, the CEO and Committees under the Board; b.
Procedures and formalities for meetings of the GMS and meetings of the Board; c Nomination, candidacy, election, removal and dismissal of Board members, the CEO and members of Committees; Coordination of activities between the Board and the CEO; Provisions relating to annual evaluation, rewards and disciplinary actions applicable to Board members, the CEO and Executive Directors; and Other activities as provided for in the Charter and other applicable provisions of law. 12. Subjects of application This Regulation shall apply to Board members, the CEO, Executive Directors, the Company Secretary, the Corporate Govemance Officer, and other relevant individuals and departments, Article 2. Explanation of terms Unless otherwise provided by the context, terms defined in the Company’s Charter shall have the same meanings when used in this Regulation. CHAPTER I GENERAL MEETING OF SHAREHOLDER Article 3. Roles, rights and obligations of the GMS a) The GMS is the highest decision-making authority of the Company, comprising all shareholders with voting rights.
The rights and obligations of the GMS are specifically provided for in Article 12 of the Company’s Charter.
